none: PAS NLM-11F1F5: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Belton
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Possibly Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly D N CONSTANTINI MAX AVG issue of 320-325. Obverse description: bust right, with tail of wreath or diadem. Obverse inscription: [-]ONST[--]. Reverse description: Wreath enclosing VOT / XX within circumferential legend. Reverse inscription: Possibly [D N CONSTANTINI MAX AVG].
